Hindustan Unilever Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors at their meeting held on May 03, 2013 has taken note of the Voluntary Open Offer for acquisition of 22.52% of the Voting Share Capital of the Company, made by Unilever PLC along with Unilever NV in its capacity as person acting in concert with the Acquirer. Further, in terms of the requirements of Regulation 26(6) the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 the Board of Directors has constituted the Independent Directors Committee to provide reasoned recommendation to the shareholders on the Voluntary Open Offer from the Acquirer. The Committee shall consist of all Independent Directors of the Company, i.e. Mr. Aditya Narayan, Mr. S. Ramadorai, Dr. R. A. Mashelkar, Mr. O. P. Bhatt and Dr. Sanjiv Misra and Mr. Aditya Narayan shall act as the Chairman of the Committee.

Hindustan Unilever Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors in their meeting held on February 13, 2008 have: 1) Adopted the Annual Accounts for the year ended December 31, 2007. The Company's turnover net of excise was Rs. 13,717.75 Crores recording an increase of 13.3% on the turnover of Rs. 12,103.39 Crores in 2006. The Profit before Tax was Rs. 2,184.52 Crores as against Rs. 1,861.68 Crores in 2006. Depreciation/amortisation for the year was Rs. 138.36 Crores as against Rs.130.16 Crores in 2006. Provision for taxation (including deferred tax) is Rs. 417.14 Crores (2006 - Rs. 321.80 Crores). Profit after Tax increased to Rs. 1,769.06 Crores (2006 - Rs. 1,539.67 Crores). Exceptional Items (net of tax) for 2007 amounted to a gain of Rs. 156.41 Crores (2006 - Rs.315.70 Crores). Net Profit stood at Rs. 1,925.47 Crores (2006 - Rs. 1,855.37 Crores). 2) considered the notice received under Section 257 of the Companies Act, 1956 for appointment of Dr. R. A. Mashelkar as a Non Executive Independent Director of the Company. The Board has recommended the appointment of Dr. R. A. Mashelkar for approval of the members of the Company. Dr. Mashelkar who is an eminent Scientist and Engineer and is presently the President of the Indian National Science Academy (INSA) and President of Global Research Alliance, a network of publicity funded R&D institute from Asia Pacific, Europe & U. S. A. will be appointed as a Director of the Company after approval of members in the forthcoming Annual General Meeting of the Company. 3) The Board has also noted that Mr. V. Narayanan, Non-Executive, Independent Director of the Company on attaining the age of 70 years will not be seeking re-appointment at the forthcoming Annual General Meeting.

Hindustan Lever Ltd. has informed the Exchange that at the meeting of the Board of Directors held on February 20, 2007, the Board also considered -(i) a proposal for transfer of the Undertaking of the Company engaged in the business of manufacture  and sale of marine products (including manufacturing facilities for (i) Surimi crabsticks, crabclaws, crab chunks and allied products at Chorwad  in Gujarat, (ii) fish fillet, crab, octopus, squids and allied products at Kuthiathode  in Kerala and (iii)  Salad shrimps, fish fillets and allied products at Aroor in Kerala) as a slump sale to a suitable party/ parties or to one or more of the subsidiaries of the Company (if that is required to facilitate the transfer) by way of sale or assignment at such consideration and with effect from such date as the Board of Directors of the Company may think fit; Accordingly, in compliance with Section 293 (1) (a) read with Section 192A of the Companies Act, 1956 and Companies (Passing of Resolution by Postal Ballot) Rules 2001, a notice is proposed to be issued to the shareholders for a postal ballot to seek their approval for the proposed transfer by way of an ordinary resolution and in this connection, the Board has appointed , Mr. S. R. Tata, Partner , A.F.Ferguson & Co. Chartered Accountants as the scrutinizer for conducting  the postal ballot, and on the basis of his report , the result of the postal ballot will be announced on March 31, 2007 at the Registered office of the Company at Mumbai.

Hindustan Lever Ltd. has informed the Exchange that at the Board Meeting of Modern Food and Nutrition Industries Limited (MFNIL) held on September 12, 2006, the Directors of MFNIL have approved the proposal for merger of MFNIL (a 100% subsidiary of Modern Food Industries Limited) with the Company, with effect from October 01, 2006. Draft Schemes, setting out the terms and conditions with regard to the above were duly approved by the Board in the said meeting and steps are now being taken to obtain the approval of the shareholders and the Hon'ble High Court of Judicature at Bombay and at Delhi for the Scheme of Amalgamation of MFNIL with the Company.

Hindustan Lever Ltd. has informed the Exchange that the BODs of the company,at a meeting held at Mumbai on October 28,2004 considered two separate proposals for transfer by way of sale or otherwise, its: (1) undertaking engaged in the manufacture of soap and soap intermediaries at Sewri, Mumbai to a subsidiary;  (2) functionalised biopolymers business including manufacturing facilities at Pondicherry. Pursuant to in principle approval of the Board for transfer of the aforesaid undertaking/business at such consideration and with effect from such date as the BODs of the company may determine,in compliance with Section 293(1) (a) read with Section 192A of the Companies Act,1956 and Companies(Passing of Resolution by Postal Ballot) Rules 2001, a notice is proposed to be issued to the shareholders for a postal ballot to seek their approval for the proposed transfers by way of ordinary resolutions.
